find: if (host.isSurfaceOpen(surface)) for (const cb of closeCbs) cb();
why: A release fires the close subscribers even when the pane was not on screen, so `route-ui.ts` disposes a preview it never built. The other direction, a release that fires nothing, is `a-replaced-customize-pane-keeps-its-webgl-context`. Under this mutation all 360 tests in hud.controls.test.ts, hud.navigation.test.ts, hud.surfaces.test.ts and hud.a11y.test.ts passed (local control run while issue #556 was open, before the new cases existed).
killedBy: createCustomizePane (issue #556) releases its subscribers only when on screen, and leaves the surface to the incoming pane
